messages.content:
Brief from the lead:
**Brief for facts worker:** Extract from the record: (1) whether the traveler claims a medical or bereavement reason; (2) fare type (refundable or nonrefundable); (3) itinerary type (domestic or international); (4) event type (carrier cancel, schedule change, or traveler cancel); (5) whether the traveler accepted the alternative; (6) hours since booking; (7) days between booking and departure. Report each as stated, with no interpretation.

Record:
task E27-15
fare: nonrefundable
itinerary: domestic
event: carrier-cancel
traveler accepted the alternative: no
hours since booking: 10
booking was made this many days before departure: 3

State only the facts the brief asks for. At most 80 words.
